{{Quote|A cargo vessel carrying a shipment of some less than legal merchandise has gotten us all into quite a bad spot. It seems as though this vessel has been leaking chemicals all over the landscape infecting a very large percentage of the local herbivores. We have an idea on how to solve the problem, but we are going to need your help.|Braganta, to a Force-sensitive spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Braganta''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Biologist/Legends|naturalist]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Braganta became concerned when a [[Transport/Legends|cargo vessel]] carrying illegal merchandise began leaking chemicals all over the landscape of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], infecting a large percentage of local [[Diet/Legends|herbivores]]. With the help of a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was undergoing [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]], several [[Falumpaset/Legends|falumpasets]] were destroyed, stymieing a spread of the chemical infestation.

==Biography==
{{Quote|What I need you to do is kill 20 Falumpaset, ''[sic]'' those are the creatures who ate up the largest portions of the sludge that was spilt. Once you've taken down 20 of them come back here and let me know."<br />"Ah those poor creatures. But I suppose it's best to destroy them before this can spread to others.|Braganta and a Force-sensitive spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] by the name of Braganta lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a major conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Branganta worked as a [[Biologist/Legends|naturalist]].<ref name="SWG" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> she learned of a [[Transport/Legends|cargo vessel]] carrying a shipment of less than legal merchandise. This vessel ended up leaking chemicals all over the landscape of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], infecting a large percentage of the local [[Diet/Legends|herbivores]], including [[Falumpaset/Legends|falumpasets]] in particular. She and her compatriots had an idea on how to solve the problem, but she required the help of someone skilled enough to accomplish the task.<ref name="SWG" />
{{GameLS|Star Wars Galaxies}}
Fortunately for Braganta, she was approached by a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] undergoing a series of [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]]. As part of their [[Jedi training/Legends|training]], the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] traveled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in search of citizens facing difficult situations. After hearing Braganta's plight, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi-to-be]] reluctantly agreed to destroy a number of the creatures who ingested the chemicals, viewing it as a time in which a greater good outweighed a lesser evil. Because the falumpasets were the creatures which ate up the largest portion of the sludge that was spilled, Braganta instructed the Force-sensitive to destroy twenty of them. The spacer accomplished this task, thus stymieing the spread of the infestation before any serious consequences could arise. Although Braganta lamented the loss of such innocent creatures, she knew it was necessary, and commended the Force-sensitive for a job well done.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Well done. You took to that quite well. Sad business, but necessary. This kind of thing happens from time to time.|Braganta, to a Force-sensitive spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
Braganta had dark skin, [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and brown-colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Committed to her job as a naturalist, Braganta proved willing to eliminate creatures that posed a threat to the ecosystem. However, as evidenced by the case of the infected falumpasets, she did not derive any enjoyment from eliminating such creatures, merely viewing it as sad, but necessary business.<ref name="SWG" />

==Equipment==
During her time as a naturalist, Braganta wore a white and brownish-gray elegant [[Clothing/Legends|gown]], along with a pair of brownish-gray dress slippers.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Oh dear, we have quite the problem.''"<br />"''I assume that is the royal 'we', correct?''"<br />"''Not exactly, so are you willing to hear the problem? Or no?''"<br />"''No. And I'm sorry I spoke to you in the first place.''"<br />"''I see. Well, thanks anyway.|Dialogue options, when players refused to accept Braganta's quest|<ref name="SWG" />}}
Braganta was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> She was added to the game on [[August 31]], [[2004]] as part of [[W:c:swg:Publish 10 Notes for 31 August 04|Publish 10]], which revamped the process for becoming a [[W:c:swg:Jedi (pre-NGE)|Jedi]] in the form of newly implemented [[W:c:swg:Padawan Trials|Padawan Trial]] [[W:c:swg:Quest|quests]].<ref name="Publish">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64187&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2004}}</ref><ref name="SWG" /> Braganta was involved in one of the sixteen trial quests that players could complete, which required the player to kill twenty [[W:c:swg:Falumpaset|falumpasets]]. Players would need to complete eight of these sixteen trial quests successfully in order to qualify as a [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]]. Because the trial quests were randomly assigned, it was possible for players to not be assigned Braganta's quest. It was also possible for players to refuse the quest, or to fail up to three of the trials before being forced to restart the entire process over again. However, this article assumes 100% game completion under the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light sided]] character choices. Each of the trial quests had a core moral that needed to be applied. In Braganta's quest, the moral was, "A Jedi must understand that there are times when a greater good outweighs a lesser evil."<ref name="SWG" /> With the release of [[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15 2005|Publish 25's]] [[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]] on [[November 15]], [[2005]], the [[W:c:swg:Jedi|Jedi]] [[W:c:swg:Profession|profession]] was once again revamped, this time to simply become a starter profession.<ref name="NGE">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> The Padawan Trial quests were rendered defunct as a result, effectively removing Braganta from the game.<ref name="SWG" />
